component.name: Cone Player
component.summary: Media player with Juxtopposed's VLC Redesign, based on VLC media player

description.p: Cone Player plays your videos and music with the interface of Juxtopposed's "VLC Redesign" (CC BY 4.0), built on the engine of VLC media player. It plays almost any file, with subtitles, chapters, bookmarks, a media library and per-show presets.
Experimental: based on the development version of VLC media player (VLC 4). Cone Player is not affiliated with or endorsed by VideoLAN or Juxtopposed.
